title: cheirolophus intybaceus var. capillifolius
intro: Cheirolophus intybaceus var. capillifolius, commonly known as the Cape Mountain Bells, is a species of flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to the Western Cape province of South Africa. The Cape Mountain Bells has been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which may contribute to its traditional uses in treating ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Cheirolophus intybaceus var. capillifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
